contract.scope: Existing organization and exact OIDC issuer; bounded SCIM Users/Groups plus discovery; no bulk, sort, compound filters, nested groups or enterprise extensions
contract.identity: Immutable externalId equals signed OIDC sub; metadata never selects/merges an account; fresh signed proof binds/reactivates exact source-owned inactive versions; independent unlink/offboarding wins
contract.roles: Only explicit viewer/developer group mappings; preserve manual floors/overrides and unrelated workspace credentials; native adoption requires fresh browser MFA/passkey and exact reviewed assignment/version/current role
contract.versions: Required exact If-Match on resource edits, with atomic embedded User/Group representation version changes
contract.replay: Exact current-authorized canonical receipt returns historical status/body/ETag without reapplying later-removed authority; changed input rejects
contract.expiry: Separate 32-1024 character credential, absolute expiry at most 366 days, positive policy revision and current persisted policy; expiry denies new SCIM calls without expiring memberships
contract.deactivation: Exact identity/workspace grants removed, all browser/recovery/generic OAuth and broad credentials revoked; unrelated scoped credentials preserved; cross-process durable live access closes

migration.transaction: Schema/policy/projection reconciliation commit together; thrown or unsupported asynchronous hooks roll back all writes and publication
migration.disabled: Deny new SCIM admission; retain ownership, inactive/deleted denials and receipts
migration.rollback: Verified compatible binary/schema snapshot; no deletion of authority/tombstones to downgrade
migration.deletedAccount: Retain subject/local UID ownership and allow metadata maintenance without recreating orphan membership or transferring ownership

runtimeEvidence.postProofEdits: Only report metadata; every runtime/test/type/canonical-guide/build input remains hash-equal
runtimeEvidence.disposable: Debian 13/Linux 6.12.111; ordinary UID 1000 on explicit QEMU disposable host; four CPUs/4 GiB; minimum Node 22.16 and Node 26.10

processProof.cleanup: Owned child processes terminated and verified exited
